main_body: small wooden bucket with a rim, a green slop strip across the top and a banded brown body, about 10px wide and 8px tall
top_band: tan/orange rim at about rows 6-7, with an olive-green slop strip and a green drip down the front. It reads as a thin rim, not an elliptical surface.
evidence: Down the middle column there is a 1-2 row light rim, then a dark and green strip. The strip reads as a flat band across the rim, not an ellipse showing the inside of the bucket. The body below is flat banded wood with horizontal hoops, viewed face-on. There is no distinct front-edge line and no eave shadow. The opening is only about 2 rows and has no interior ellipse, so this matches the 'rim only' and front-elevation failures in the guide.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood, which is fine. The wood has about 3-4 tones (tan, orange, mid brown, dark brown) and the slop is only 1-2 greens. The tiny sprite has little grain or dot texture, and its tiles hold about 3-6 colours, far below the references' per-tile richness. The pale blue-grey patch above it adds little. It reads thinner and flatter than the stall and well references.
